title: MarginEvaluationRequest
description: Versioned NATS request envelope and payload contract for synchronous margin evaluation.

currency.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code (e.g. THB, USD, JPY)

scale.description: ISO 4217 minor unit exponent scale (e.g. 0 for JPY, 2 for THB/USD)

price_minor.description: Base selling price before discount in integer minor units (Article V zero-float invariant)

candidate_discount_minor.description: Proposed discount amount in integer minor units

cogs_minor.description: Cost of goods sold in integer minor units

platform_fee_minor.description: Platform commission and transaction fees in integer minor units

shipping_fee_minor.description: Seller-subsidized shipping cost in integer minor units

giveaway_cost_minor.description: Optional gift or giveaway cost in integer minor units

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key for deduplication and replay safety
